assay: bulk RNA-seq, poly-A stranded, NovaSeq 6000, C2C12 mouse myotubes (S5.8.p1)
primary_estimand: Transcriptional response of control-LNA C2C12 myotubes to in-vitro simulated exercise (3 h electrical pulse stimulation), immediately after (EPS 0h) and after 3 h recovery (EPS 3h), each versus Rest (S2.5.p2, FIG7)
sample_inclusion: 36 libraries = 2 LNA x 3 EPS conditions x 6 (triplicate wells from two independent experiments) (S5.8.p1, FIG7 legend)
planned_contrasts: Control EPS 0h vs Control Rest (S2.5.p2; paper: 835 genes UP, log2FC>1, FDR<0.01)
Control EPS 3h vs Control Rest (S2.5.p2; paper: 1316 genes UP, log2FC>1, FDR<0.01)
Tug1 KD vs Control at Rest (S2.5.p1; 867 DEGs FDR<0.01) - not an exercise contrast, out of scope
EPS response in Tug1 KD vs control (FIG7E/F, blunted/augmented genes) - modulation of the exercise response, exploratory here
repeated_measure_unit: none; each library is one well (independent cultures); wells come from two independent experiments (S5.8.p1)
normalization: Degust voom/limma; genes with >=1 RPM in >=12 of 36 libraries (S5.8.p2)
paper_method: limma-voom in Degust v4.1.5 on the 36 libraries (S5.8.p2)

paper_results.genes: Hspa1a, Atf3, Nr4a3 up at EPS 0h; Gabpa up with EPS; Nrf1/Tfam not up; Ppargc1a not DE at FDR 0.05 (S2.5.p2, S2.5.p4)
